───────────────────────────── kosmera skills sync ──────────────────────────────

Usage
  kosmera skills sync [options]

Description
  Downloads the Kosmera skill package for an AI provider, pinned by version,
  and writes it into that tool's own location in the current project so the AI
  tool knows how to build Kosmera apps.

  The resolved version is recorded in .kosmera/skills.lock.json,
  so re-running the command is a no-op until the version or the package changes.

  Synced files are managed content: a file you have edited by hand is replaced
  by the pinned version, with a warning naming it. Use --dry-run to see that
  before it happens. A file the new version no longer ships is never deleted
  if you have edited it.

Options
  -p, --provider <id>   AI provider to sync for (default: claude)
      --version <tag>   Skills version to pin (default: v0.1.0)
      --source <src>    Skills repository URL or local mirror directory
      --path <dir>      Project directory (default: current directory)
      --dry-run         Show what would change without writing anything
  -h, --help            Show help for this command

Configuration
  Source and version resolve in this order: command line, environment
  (KOSMERA_SKILLS_SOURCE, KOSMERA_SKILLS_VERSION), CLI configuration
  (skills_source, skills_version), then the built-in default.

  Default source: https://github.com/Locwise/kosmera-skills
  The default source is a public repository; no sign-in is required.

Examples
  kosmera skills sync
  kosmera skills sync --provider claude --version v0.2.0
  kosmera skills sync --source /mnt/mirrors/kosmera-skills --dry-run
